card.name: Final pieces of drug names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug or chemical name split into parts, such as the ending of bromide, sulfide, carbonate, perphenazine, carisoprodol or haloperidol. It appears in dosing, toxicity and interaction text.

modes.label: Inorganic salt endings
modes.description: The closing piece of a salt or compound name like bromide, sulfide or carbonate.

card.writes: It favors odd word-continuation pieces and suppresses "of" and China/US words, so there is no clear output effect beyond name completion.
card.plain: It lights up on the final chunk of a long drug name, such as the "-azine" in perphenazine or "-ide" in bromide.
